What other secrets does this city hold? It turns out that these wretches have decided to make an attempt on my humble person because I could get my hands on the cargo which was carried by this very convoy. The simple-minded snakes don't even realize that they're the ones who led me to this cargo with their own hands. Did they really think they could scare me with some cheap blackmail? Me?! All right, listen to me, your job is to secure the area around the intersection and mark the location of the cargo with a beacon. My men will do the rest.}} ==Requirements== * Unlocks 10 hours after completion of [[Make an Impression]] ==Objectives== * Locate the transport holding the cargo on [[Streets of Tarkov]] * Secure the area from 50 hostile PMC operatives * Mark the cargo area with an [[MS2000 Marker]] * Launch a yellow flare near the armored convoy to confirm that the job is done * Survive and extract from the location '''Note:''' The "Mark" and "Flare" objectives will appear after the "Secure" objective is completed. ==Rewards== * [[Lightkeeper]] Rep '''+0.05''' * 1× [[Advanced current converter]] * Unlocks barter for [[Advanced current converter]] at [[Mechanic]] LL4 * Unlocks purchase of [[SIG MCX-SPEAR 6.8x51 assault rifle]] at [[Peacekeeper]] LL4 * Unlocks purchase of [[AR-10 7.62x51 Lancer L7AWM 25-round magazine]] at [[Peacekeeper]] LL4 * Unlocks purchase of [[6.8x51mm SIG Hybrid]] at [[Peacekeeper]] LL4 {{quote|The positions for Zryachy that you recently prepared have come in handy. He successfully eliminated several conspirators. Now, after you've cleaned up the area and marked the cargo, it's just a matter of opening the secured door and finding out what was it that they were transporting that was so valuable. Judging by the people involved in this conspiracy, there may be something in there that could blow the heads off not only of the corporation, but of some very high-ranking people as well. Looks like we're in for some great business, mercenary. Keep in touch.}} ==Guide== {|class="wikitable" ! colspan="6" |Related Quest Items |- !Icon !Item name !Amount !Requirement !'''[[Found in raid|Find in Raid]]''' !Notes |- ![[File:MS2000 Marker icon.png|link=MS2000 Marker]] |[[MS2000 Marker]] |1 |Required !N/A |This item is placed at the grate door inside the cargo truck trailer. When placed, the item is removed from the players' inventory. |- ! colspan="6" |Flare - You only need one of the below options |- ![[File:Yellow flare icon.png|link=RSP-30 reactive signal cartridge (Yellow)]] |[[RSP-30 reactive signal cartridge (Yellow)]] |1 |Required !N/A |Must be fired into the sky while being in the convoy area. |- ! colspan="6" |OR |- ![[File:SP-81 Icon.png|link=ZiD SP-81 26x75 signal pistol]] |[[ZiD SP-81 26x75 signal pistol]] |1 |Required !N/A |Used to fire the flare cartridge |- ![[File:26x75 flare cartridge (Yellow) icon.png|link=26x75mm flare cartridge (Yellow)]] |[[26x75mm flare cartridge (Yellow)]] |1 |Required !N/A |Must be fired into the sky while being in the convoy area. |} In this quest you first have to locate the armored convoy and kill 50 PMCs on [[Streets of Tarkov]]. Next you have to place a [[MS2000 Marker]] at the grate door inside the cargo truck trailer from the convoy. Afterwards you have to shoot a yellow flare into the sky while being in the convoy area. If the flare doesn't reach a certain height, the quest objective won't complete. You can use either the [[RSP-30 reactive signal cartridge (Yellow)|handheld RSP-30 yellow flare]] which can be bought at [[Prapor]] LL1 or a [[26x75mm flare cartridge (Yellow)|26x75mm yellow flare cartridge]] which can be bought at [[Jaeger]] LL1, and is fired from a [[ZiD SP-81 26x75 signal pistol|signal pistol]]. If you use the [[RSP-30 reactive signal cartridge (Yellow)|handheld RSP-30 yellow flare]], make sure to aim it upwards, but not too much or it lands behind you.
